rule_name: Condition governs permitted operation
rule_statement: The same body cannot infer its permitted operation from actor identity or positional role alone; the governing state must be satisfied. When the cloud remains, the camp waits; when the cloud lifts and journey is authorized, the assigned march order executes.
consequence_signature: wait/hold under abide state
execute movement under lifted/authorized state
interpretation_ceiling: Do not infer readiness, fear, failure, or generic symbolism from the marker; the relation is source-defined.

rule_name: Actor jurisdiction cannot be inferred from sequence position alone
rule_statement: First position or proximity cannot self-authorize an actor; operation requires source-assigned jurisdiction, and different participants retain distinct roles.
consequence_signature: assigned actor executes only within that jurisdiction
interpretation_ceiling: Do not equate first position with guaranteed outcome or autonomous authority.

rule_name: Changed outcome/history can invalidate automatic repetition
rule_statement: A prior authorization cannot automatically authorize repetition after the operation produces a changed outcome condition; the continuation question must be re-adjudicated.
consequence_signature: re-inquire before repeating
prior command is neither retroactively false nor automatically repeatable
interpretation_ceiling: Failure alone does not prove the first authorization false; the rule concerns changed condition before continuation.

rule_name: Signal cannot substitute for underlying state
rule_statement: A signal is operable only inside the state and target relation that gives it meaning; the signal does not create the condition it communicates.
condition_signature: target group is next in ordered march
consequence_signature: signal transmits movement cue to that target
interpretation_ceiling: Do not transfer the same signal mechanically to unrelated calendar or offering contexts.

rule_name: No single coordinate defines a multi-domain appointed state
rule_statement: A calendar/date coordinate alone cannot determine every appointed operation; land/material state, counted history, custody, participant condition, place, actor/body operation and prohibition can be independent required variables.
condition_signature: one or more additional canon-defined domains
consequence_signature: operation fitness differs when required domain inputs differ or are omitted
interpretation_ceiling: Do not promote any one celestial, calendar, land, or social variable into a universal trigger.

rule_name: Counted history generates later state
rule_statement: A later appointed state can be generated through a counted transition from a prior embodied event; skipping the count destroys the transition history and turns a process into a static token.
consequence_signature: later state becomes available only through completed transition history
interpretation_ceiling: Do not replace the canon-defined counted process with a fixed date when the text supplies a generated transition.

rule_name: Place is a jurisdiction variable, not decorative geography
rule_statement: A correct date or action cannot by itself make an operation valid when the canon requires a chosen place; moving the operation outside its stated jurisdiction changes its fitness.
consequence_signature: same operation is valid or invalid according to jurisdictional placement
interpretation_ceiling: Do not reduce chosen-place language to decorative location or infer that every operation requires the same place.

rule_name: Participant condition changes operation availability
rule_statement: The calendar coordinate alone cannot settle operation fitness when participant eligibility/condition is canonically specified; manifested participant condition can delay, exclude, or alter participation.
consequence_signature: participation availability/timing changes
interpretation_ceiling: Do not infer a generic bodily rule beyond the states where participant condition is explicitly linked to operation availability.

rule_name: State-specific prohibition is part of the operation contract
rule_statement: An appointed state cannot be fully specified by date/label alone because distinct prohibited operations are part of its identity and differ across states.
consequence_signature: some actions are disallowed under that state while allowed elsewhere
interpretation_ceiling: Do not collapse all prohibitions into one generic feast rule or infer them from date alone.

rule_name: Duration and exit are part of state identity
rule_statement: A state cannot be reduced to its entry instant; defined persistence, completion, exit, assembly, eighth-day or subsequent transition conditions can be part of what the state is.
consequence_signature: state persists and then transitions according to its own exit rule
interpretation_ceiling: Do not treat every appointed state as a point-date.

rule_name: Differentiation establishes lawful relation without annihilating either side
rule_statement: Two real conditions cannot remain in undifferentiated overlap once the Source-governed distinction is made; separation establishes lawful differentiated relation while both conditions remain.
consequence_signature: conditions occupy differentiated relation rather than overlap
neither condition is necessarily destroyed
interpretation_ceiling: The separation operation is morally neutral in itself; darkness is not thereby classified as evil.

rule_name: Naming/addressability cannot be equated with essence creation
rule_statement: Designation can stabilize addressability and jurisdiction of already differentiated conditions without creating their material essence.
consequence_signature: conditions become stably addressable within an ordered cycle
interpretation_ceiling: Do not treat naming as ontological magic or infer all later ritual timing from Genesis 1:5.

rule_name: Relational/legal status is independent of material identity
rule_statement: The same material object can occupy different lawful, ritual, or cultic statuses without ceasing to be the same material object; material identity alone cannot determine operation fitness.
consequence_signature: clean/unclean, legitimate/illicit, or authorized/unauthorized status changes
interpretation_ceiling: Do not infer that material form itself is morally or ritually fixed; each passage supplies its own relation/status condition.

rule_name: Membership relation governs productive capacity
rule_statement: A participant's capacity cannot be inferred from participant identity alone when the text defines a sustaining membership relation; branch participation, removal, grafting, remaining and bearing are relation-dependent.
consequence_signature: bearing/participation differs with relation
removal and reinsertion are possible under stated conditions
interpretation_ceiling: Preserve exact passage relations; do not settle full covenant/root ontology from the organic mechanics alone.

rule_name: Fitness can be lost and restored without identity replacement
rule_statement: Material identity or provenance cannot alone settle usability; under stated conditions a participant/material can move from unfit/unclean to fit/clean through a defined process.
consequence_signature: status becomes fit/clean while identity remains
interpretation_ceiling: Do not infer one universal purification mechanism; processes differ by material and text.

rule_name: Movement-to-planting sequence establishes stabilized dwelling
rule_statement: The transition from mobility to planted dwelling is ordered: movement/bringing, appointed place, planting, and dwelling are related stages rather than interchangeable labels.
consequence_signature: settled dwelling/stability follows the ordered transition
interpretation_ceiling: Do not universalize every planting lexeme to settlement or apply this sequence to unrelated planting texts.

rule_name: A single referent can undergo an ordered state-chain across changing operations
rule_statement: The canon can preserve referent continuity across a long ordered sequence of removal, planting, rooting, extension, breach, burning, visitation and strengthening; the referent is not reducible to any one surface operation.
consequence_signature: later condition depends on prior state-chain rather than one isolated action
interpretation_ceiling: The psalm itself supplies the people/vine overlay; exact identity linkage of later individual referents remains separate.

rule_name: Ordered physical arrangement is functionally significant
rule_statement: In the sacrificial combustion construction, altar, fire, wood and offering parts are placed in a specified order; the parts cannot be treated as an unordered inventory without losing the described operation structure.
consequence_signature: combustion operation is constructed through ordered arrangement
interpretation_ceiling: Do not infer a universal sacrificial mechanism from extraordinary fire events or collapse distinct structures/lexemes.

rule_name: A reciprocal relation can preserve one law under reversed participant direction
rule_statement: The same exousia relation is stated reciprocally with participant direction reversed; the law is relational rather than a one-way property of one participant class.
condition_signature: same relation applied in opposite participant direction
consequence_signature: each stands in the corresponding reversed relation to the other
interpretation_ceiling: No unilateral polarity or broader household ontology is encoded by the function observation itself.

rule_name: Timing window changes legal consequence of the same relation
rule_statement: The legal effect of hearing/confirming/annulling a commitment depends on when the response occurs; the same participant relation cannot be evaluated independently of timing history.
condition_signature: response occurs within or after specified timing window
consequence_signature: commitment stands, is annulled, or late-annulment liability attaches
interpretation_ceiling: Preserve the passage-specific legal relation; do not universalize the household rule beyond its stated cases.

rule_name: Human agency alone cannot determine lawful status
rule_statement: The same human making/planting agency can appear on both lawful and prohibited sides; authorization, recipient, placement and configuration must therefore be tracked separately.
consequence_signature: one configuration is lawful while another is prohibited
interpretation_ceiling: The evidence does not by itself identify which single variable fully explains the prohibition; several relational variables remain candidates.

rule_name: Shared calendar container does not make states operationally identical
rule_statement: States sharing the same month or broad appointed family cannot be collapsed into one operation contract; different dates/states carry different verbs, body operations, purposes and prohibitions.
consequence_signature: operation/prohibition bundle differs by state
interpretation_ceiling: Do not infer one homogeneous festival state from shared month or overlapping labels.

rule_name: Overlay recurrence does not define underlying state identity
rule_statement: A repeated offering schedule can overlay heterogeneous states without making those states identical; recurring surface operation cannot substitute for full state definition.
consequence_signature: shared overlay coexists with distinct state-specific contracts
interpretation_ceiling: Do not treat repeated offering formulae as the sole identity of the states they overlay.

rule_name: Condition and consequence must remain directionally separated
rule_statement: A marker, outcome, or failure cannot be reverse-inferred into the condition that authorizes or explains the operation unless the canon explicitly supplies that reverse relation.
consequence_signature: reverse inference is blocked unless independently stated
interpretation_ceiling: Do not infer anger from sunset, fear from waiting, or invalid prior authorization from failure alone.
